definitions.explanation: A status marking that a payment has already been received or a deposit made. Common in online shopping, invoicing, and accounting to flag an order or account as settled.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}は{入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みです。
examples.english: The order has already been paid for.

examples.japanese: {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みの{お客様|きゃくさま}には{確認|かくにん}メールが{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: Customers who have already paid will receive a confirmation email.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みのため、{明日|あした}{発送|はっそう}される{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: Since payment for this product has been received, it is scheduled to ship tomorrow.

notes:
Combines {入金|にゅうきん} (deposit of money) with {済|ず}み (completed), marking that a payment has already been received. Often used attributively as {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みの.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みの{注文|ちゅうもん}: an order that has been paid
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みになる: to become marked as paid
- {入金|にゅうきん}{済|ず}みマーク: a paid mark or stamp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み: payment completed — seen from the payer's side
- {未入金|みにゅうきん}: payment not yet received — the opposite status
